How to Check Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026?

The candidates can check and download their Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 online through the official website of Join Indian Army. Keep your registration details at hand and follow the steps below to download your result PDF and check your qualifying status.

  1. Visit Join Indian Army Official Website.
  2. Click on the Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 link.
  3. Select your ARO or recruitment zone, if applicable.
  4. Open the result PDF displayed on screen.
  5. Ctrl + F and search with your Roll Number/ Registration Number.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

What After Army Agniveer Result 2026?

Check the ARO-wise PDF, download rally admit card and appear for recruitment Rally after Indian Army result Agniveer 2026. In the recruitment rally, they have to appear for document verification, physical measurements and fitness tests such as a 1.6 km run, pull-ups and ditch jump. For preparing the final merit list, the candidates are ranked on CEE and PFT scores. The top-ranked candidates are given dispatch orders under the Agnipath scheme and start training for four years at the designated centres.

Indian Army Agniveer Phase 2 Selection Process 2026

Indian Army Agniveer Phase 2 recruitment process will be conducted for those candidates who qualify the written examination. The physical fitness test (PFT), physical measurement test (PMT) and medical examination to assess the overall fitness of the candidates are involved in this phase.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT)

The Physical Fitness Test evaluates a candidate’s physical endurance and strength. Candidates must qualify all the required events to move to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Group 1.6 Km Run Time Marks for Run Pull-Ups Required Marks for Pull-Ups 9 Feet Ditch Zig-Zag Balance
Group I Up to 5 Minutes 30 Seconds 60 10 40 Qualifying Qualifying
Group II 5 Minutes 31 Seconds to 5 Minutes 45 Seconds 48 9 33 Qualifying Qualifying
8 27 Qualifying Qualifying
7 21 Qualifying Qualifying
6 16 Qualifying Qualifying

Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

The Physical Measurement Test checks whether candidates meet the physical standards prescribed by the Indian Army. Candidates must satisfy all the required measurements to proceed further.

Parameter Requirement
Height As per Army standards for the respective category
Chest Required chest expansion as prescribed
Weight Proportionate to height and age as per Army standards

Medical Examination

The Medical Examination ensures that candidates are medically fit for service in the Indian Army. Only medically fit candidates will be considered for the final merit list.

Medical Standard Requirement
Eyesight As per Army medical standards
Hearing Normal hearing ability
Chest X-ray Must be clear and satisfactory
Blood & Urine Tests Must meet prescribed medical standards
Tattoos No permanent tattoos except in permitted areas
Overall Fitness Must be medically fit as per Indian Army norms

How is the Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 Prepared?

The Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 is prepared on the basis of the candidate’s performance in the Common Entrance Examination (CEE) and released as an ARO-wise and category-wise PDF. After the post-evaluation and normalisation (if required) of the CBT, the Indian Army releases a merit list of candidates who have scored the required cut-off marks. The result PDF includes the roll numbers or names of the shortlisted candidates who are eligible to attend the Phase 2 Recruitment Rally, which consists of Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Document Verification and Medical Examination.

What is the Difference Between Agniveer Result, Merit List, and Selection List?

The Agniveer Result, Merit List and Selection List are released at different stages of the recruitment process and serve different purposes. Candidates should understand the distinction to avoid confusion during recruitment.

Particular Agniveer Result Agniveer Merit List Agniveer Selection List
Released After Common Entrance Examination (CEE) Completion of evaluation and ranking Completion of all recruitment stages
Purpose Shortlists candidates for Phase 2 Ranks candidates based on performance Confirms final selection for enrolment
Includes Qualified candidates for Rally Candidates arranged according to merit Final selected candidates
Next Stage PFT, PMT, Document Verification & Medical Final verification Training and joining formalities

Will the Indian Army Release Individual Scorecards?

No, generally the Indian Army does not provide individual scorecards for the Agniveer Common Entrance Examination (CEE). The result is published as PDF of ARO wise and category wise merit lists on the official Join Indian Army website. Candidates can check their qualification status by searching their roll number or registration number in the PDF. Individual marks of the candidates are not usually shown separately unless notified by the Indian Army.
